scientific_integrity.claim: Sharp global input-output constants: diagonal entries 3/2, off-diagonal 9/8; neither is attained by distinct finite matrices; block embedding yields lower bound 3/2 in every higher dimension.
scientific_integrity.domain: Real symmetric 2x2 matrices; Frobenius nearest positive-semidefinite projection; entrywise maximum-norm input perturbations and coordinatewise output errors.
limitations: No sharp constants for n>=3, complex Hermitian matrices, alternate norms, or correlation constraints.
The 2015 source was inspectable only through its abstract; no full-text coverage claim is made.

The day-verified 2006-07-05 source date is the accessible Manchester repository deposit date for a 1988 article. Its 1988 public journal month precedes that deposit, but the original public day was not independently verified.

title: Sharp diagonal and off-diagonal amplification in two-by-two semidefinite projection
